messages.subject: FY2026 Scope 2 inventory — please run it today
messages.bodyPreview: Hi desk — the board items are set up and the summary page placeholder is in SUST. Please work it end to end today under the protocol in force. I am in the assurance planning call most of the day.

messages.subject: FY2026 steam statement + verified 2025 plant factor
messages.bodyPreview: Attached the FY2026 statement lines for RDE-HW-2207 (Hartwell). Your account remains closed-loop with condensate credit on every line. Our 2025 plant factor of 58.20 kg CO2e/MMBtu was verified by Arden Assurance LLP (limited assurance, ISAE 3410, signed 20 March 2026); the statement is in your Box supplier folder.

messages.subject: Lowell — indicative 2025 emission factor
messages.bodyPreview: As requested: our internally calculated 2025 factor after the co-firing trial is 44.10 kg CO2e/MMBtu. It is preliminary and not yet verified; we expect third-party verification in Q1 2027. Your Lowell Industrial Park service is open-discharge (no condensate return).

messages.subject: Albany chilled water — FY2026 annual statement
messages.bodyPreview: The FY2026 annual statement for CCE-ALB-031 is issued: measured plant annual COP 5.2 for Oct 2025 – Sep 2026 (all-in, plant boundary). Nameplate COP of the new chillers is 6.1 for information.

messages.subject: Your Plano statement
messages.bodyPreview: Thank you for being a Legacy customer. Your FY2026 ton-hours are on the portal. Our plant delivers best-in-class efficiency of up to 6.0 COP. Measured annual COP will be published with the FY2027 statement after the metering upgrade.

messages.subject: FY2026 retirement confirmations
messages.bodyPreview: Snapshot as at 9 October sent separately (see the .eml in your working folder). The Airtable registry mirror is the live view and is synced nightly; if a registry corrects a retirement the mirror shows it the next sync. NRR-2026-0091-SOL is still Active pending the December window.

messages.subject: my FY2026 draft workings
messages.bodyPreview: Put my draft in the data folder (scope2-fy2026-draft-workings-dr.csv). I used EFS-2026.1 since it is newest and more accurate, and meter totals everywhere because they are more granular. Gdańsk looks tiny — probably mostly warehousing. Feel free to just copy the numbers onto the board.

messages.bodyPreview: Coventry has ~1,100 MWh of REGO above its consumption. Last year we moved the surplus to Leeds — can you do the same on the board this year? Leeds' GO should cover the rest.
